Resulting CIP-0102 folder in master branch: https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0102

ms.promise:
A survey of Cardano developers showing which language they'd prefer to see onchain reference implementations done in.A reference implementation stored in the CIP 102 folder in the CIPs repository, which demonstrates:
・Minting a CIP 102 compliant NFT with royalties
・Reading a CIP 102 NFT’s royalties off chain
・Reading and validating against CIP 102 NFT royalties on chain

This reference implementation will be written in Typescript for the offchain code, PlutusTx or Aiken (or some other language), depending on survey results, for the onchain code.
ms.criteria:
The survey has been conducted.
The pull request for the reference implementation has been approved and merged to master.
ms.report:
The poll I ran to determine the onchain language resulted in 75% of votes for Aiken: https://x.com/ikigai_sam/status/1713964753331339343

I opened a pull request with the reference implementation here: https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/pull/848

The editors informed me in the pull request that reference implementations will no longer be kept in the CIPs repository, but in their own separate repository.

The new repository for the reference implementation is here:
https://github.com/SamDelaney/CIP_102_Reference
